context.title: Conditional on the path-coefficient transposition count: OR-relaxation transfer for AND/OR fan-in-two circuits (soundness, domination, cost)
context.unlocks: Rung 0, one output: the bound for every plane circuit, by its number of mixed cross gates

eligibility: unknown: consult live desk; public posting does not confer ownership

public_research.plain_statement: Assume the path-coefficient count. Let C be an AND/OR circuit, gates listing two earlier wires, on points then lines, reading only S, W. A cross gate: an AND with no line-free input and not two point-free inputs; a view makes each an OR of one input, C^or an OR. (a) If no view accepts (X, {w}), X in S off w, |X| <= R, no C^or frontier wire with line set {w} has a true path coefficient at X. (b) A view's coefficient at its frontier g is below C^or's at each point-free h below g via ORs mixed in C; h is C^or-frontier. (c) Then t_x + 3 t_m point gates give these ORs.
